envelope.description: Stage typed packet descriptors with bounded memory ownership

body.title: Stage typed packet descriptors with bounded memory ownership
body.summary: Extend the existing prepared-context codec/store with proposed typed packet/task/file descriptor indexes, bounded leaf/window access and explicit release; unify live-memory charging with source staging and host disk reservations. Add derived encoding version checks without changing pinned history or CRs.
acceptanceChecks: Document and implement descriptor lookup, bounded window acquisition/release and cancellation ownership in existing review-context modules; no new DB or eager compatibility path.

Reserve before allocation for shared binary buffers, UTF-16 strings, metadata/index shards and encoder/decoder scratch; release only after final owner. Staged immutable leaves retain complete content/digests and aggregate disk reservation.

Round-trip byte arrays, Unicode, null/undefined and ordered descriptor references; reject unknown/old derived encodings and foreign/tampered objects before use. Partial generation never grants readiness; unchanged64MiB memory/256MiBcache/4MiBbatch defaults.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Typed staged descriptor/leaf codec and shared memory accounting: byte/Unicode/null/order round-trip, shard/version/tamper rejection, reserve-before-allocation and exact window release.
Staged view capacity ownership: aggregate disk reservations, partial sealing, borrowed-window cancellation and two-session memory/disk pressure retain complete evidence.
